settings.description: Three focused services. Each one ends with clear next steps, not generic advice.

settings.subtitle: Three focused services. Each one ends with clear, written next steps.
settings.video_subtitle: Watch this short walkthrough before you book.
settings.video_text: See how to pick a date, complete the intake form and schedule your Relocation Strategy or Contract Review session. For the Canada Teacher Pathway Assessment, your intake form link arrives straight after purchase.

settings.title: Relocation Strategy Session
settings.summary: For teachers choosing a country or preparing an international move.
settings.features:
Deep dive into your personal and professional priorities
Targeted country selection strategy
C.V. and cover letter review and optimisation
Interview technique preparation
Written action plan delivered within 24 hours
settings.note: Your scheduling link arrives by email after purchase.

settings.title: Canada Teacher Pathway Assessment
settings.summary: For teachers trained outside Canada who want a clear, personalised route into Canadian classrooms.
settings.features:
Teacher profile summary and Canada Pathway Report
Readiness score (a planning indicator)
Document checklist tailored to you
90-day action roadmap
30-minute debrief and 30 days of limited follow-up
settings.note: Report within 5 business days of a complete intake.

settings.title: Contract Review Session
settings.summary: For teachers holding an international offer who want to know what's normal, and what's missing, before signing.
settings.features:
Line-by-line contract analysis before you sign
Hidden red flags and missing clauses identified
Salary benchmarking against the market rate
Negotiation coaching and exact phrasing to use
Benefit evaluation (housing, insurance, flights)
settings.note: Have your offer ready to share.

settings.question: Which service should I choose?
settings.answer: Aiming for Canada? Start with the Canada Teacher Pathway Assessment. Moving somewhere else, or still choosing? Choose Relocation Strategy. Holding an offer? Choose Contract Review.

settings.question: Do you guarantee a job or certification?
settings.answer: No. We're not a recruiter or a certification body. We help you make informed decisions and prepare well.

settings.question: Is this immigration advice?
settings.answer: No. Teacher Moves doesn't give immigration advice. For immigration questions, use official IRCC information or a licensed RCIC or lawyer.

settings.question: Can I reschedule my session?
settings.answer: Yes. You can reschedule up to 24 hours before your session using the link in your confirmation email.

settings.question: Is my payment secure?
settings.answer: Yes. Payments are processed securely through Shopify checkout. We never see or store your card details.
